name: Calendula (Pot marigold)

schedule.notes: Or start indoors 4 to 6 weeks earlier. Tolerates light frost.
Fall sowings in zones 7+ overwinter and bloom early.
Pick flowers daily — bushier plants and more blooms result.

harvest.cues: Flowers fully open, sticky petals (resin = good salve!), yellow to deep orange.
harvest.storageNotes: Petals dry beautifully — pull off the disk-center, dry petals on screen, store in jars for tea, soup color, or skin salves.

varieties.name: Resina
varieties.notes: Bred for high resin content. The healing-salve variety.

varieties.name: Pacific Beauty Mix
varieties.notes: Mixed yellow/orange/cream. Long-stemmed for cut flowers.

notes: Easy, productive, self-seeds reliably. Petals are edible (mild, slightly bitter) and add saffron-like color to rice. Resin-rich varieties make a classic skin-healing salve infused in oil.
